title: INTEREST OF CAPA-MEDIUM CULTURE MEDIUM DURING IN VITRO MATURATION FOR THE MANAGEMENT OF POLYCYSTIC OVARY SYNDROME IN ASSISTED REPRODUCTIVE TECHNOLOGY
official: INTEREST OF CAPA-MEDIUM CULTURE MEDIUM DURING IN VITRO MATURATION FOR THE MANAGEMENT OF POLYCYSTIC OVARY SYNDROME IN ASSISTED REPRODUCTIVE TECHNOLOGY
summary: The OPKAPAMIV study is a monocentric, open-label clinical trial evaluating the effectiveness of CAPA-MEDIUM culture medium for in vitro maturation (IVM) of oocytes in women with polycystic ovary syndrome (PCOS) undergoing assisted reproductive technology. The primary objective is to achieve a 60% maturation rate of immature cumulus-oocyte complexes (COCs) retrieved from PCOS patients. Secondary objectives include assessing fertilization, blastulation, implantation, pregnancy, and live birth rates, as well as monitoring the health of children born from these procedures. The study also compares outcomes between fresh and vitrified oocytes. The protocol aims to improve safety and success rates for PCOS patients, reducing the risk of ovarian hyperstimulation syndrome by avoiding conventional ovarian stimulation.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Women aged 18 to 37 years (inclusive).
* Men aged 18 to 58 years (inclusive).
* PCOS diagnosis based on modified Rotterdam criteria.
* At least one previous IVF +/- ICSI cycle with failed stimulation or oocyte retrieval showing poor oocyte and/or embryo quality.
* Antral follicle count (AFC) ≥ 50.
* Signed informed consent (free, informed, and written consent).
* Affiliation with a social security system or being a beneficiary of such a system.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Abnormal karyotype.
* Endometriosis grade \>2.
* Contraindication to pregnancy.
* Contraindication to general anesthesia.
* Difficult oocyte retrieval predicted by ultrasound (e.g., BMI \>30).
* Women with contraindications to ART or associated pathologies, including : - Hypertension (HTN), risk of eclampsia, viral infection risk, family genetic disorders, diabetes, uterine anomalies (septations, synechiae/adhesions, adenomyosis), Any other condition deemed a contraindication by the investigator.
* Severe male infertility (cryptozoospermia or azoospermia).
* Individuals under legal guardianship or curatorship.
* Vulnerable populations: Persons deprived of liberty, individuals receiving psychiatric care, persons admitted to a healthcare or social institution, adults under legal protection measures, and individuals unable to express their consent.
